We connect candidates with the most attractive employers in Romania. Below you can find a selection of jobs from top companies in Romania.
What we are looking for Were looking for a hands-on Site Reliability Engineer to join our team and help us build infrastructure that is reliable, scalable, and easy to evolve. This role is a good fit for someone who enjoys staying close to the software products and services and making technical decisions in a practical way. Youll work with various tech stack in a multi-cloud environments, helping the team deliver reliable systems, improve existing infrastructure and balance speed with long-term stability and maintainability. What youll be doing: Building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines with GitLab Writing automation in Python Managing deployments with GitOps (FluxCD) Provisioning infrastructure as code with Terraform and Ansible Setting up and tuning monitoring/observability with Prometheus Operator, Grafana, and Victoria Metrics Managing logs and analysis with ELK stack Handling secrets properly with HashiCorp Vault and External Secrets Operator Working across Kubernetes and multi-cloud environments both public and private: Google Cloud Platform, Microsoft Azure, on-prem hybrid Orange Cloud Supporting database reliability for MySQL and PostgreSQL Contributing to incident response, root cause analysis, and post-mortems -- turning incidents into prevention, not repetition What you need to have: A solid Linux/Unix knowledge applied in engineering background for software products, systems and services Experience with scripting/programming languages such as Python, Go, Java or Bash Hands-on experience with cloud containers and Kubernetes environments Good understanding of CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code and automation principles Experience with observability and monitoring ( metrics, logs, distributed tracing), good understanding of SRE principles, including SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, incident management and reliability engineering An automation-first mindset: manual, repetitive work should feel like a problem to solve with reliability as a built-in product. Whats in it for you Performance Bonuses - based on your results & the companys Electronic Meal Tickets - as you imagine Medical & Life insurance for you - facilities for your family, too #WFH & Flexible hours Professional GSM subscription Personal GSM subscription, also [because we believe in communication!]  Special grants on Smartphones & devices; discounts for Orange products & services Development Platforms - Orange Learning, Trainings, Career Counselling, Coaching & Career plan mentoring Wellbeing Programs - we support your Zen
